evidence.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Daisy Chain Fields Festival donates $20 million to nonprofits for women and girls

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Uma Iyer's statement
occurrences.quote_span: “We work on really hard things every day,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: Uma Iyer
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields philanthropy village program and booth records
occurrences.quote_span: Festivalgoers can collect pins from each booth as they learn about health services from Planned Parenthood’s local partners or pay tribute to caregivers through the National Domestic Workers Alliance.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Melissa Shaw's statement
occurrences.quote_span: “It’s really important for me as a parent to expose my daughter to celebrities who set that example,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: Melissa Shaw
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Planned Parenthood social media posts and video archives
occurrences.quote_span: As she did with other nonprofits, the three-time Grammy winner appeared in informational videos on Planned Parenthood’s social media.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields Festival financial and donation records
occurrences.quote_span: Evoking the same do-it-yourself pop-rock feminism of her ‘90s musical influences, Olivia Rodrigo raised $20 million for women’s well-being with a benefit show that activated her young audience.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Festival nonprofit partner participation records
occurrences.quote_span: The festival’s nonprofit partners were eager to join that multigenerational community of women, too.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Olivia Rodrigo's Friday remarks
occurrences.quote_span: Speaking Friday alongside the beneficiaries, Rodrigo said the festival’s artists and activists give her hope despite the “regression of women’s rights” today.
occurrences.speaker: Olivia Rodrigo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: National Domestic Workers Alliance policy and demographic records
occurrences.quote_span: Her organization works to ensure federal workplace protections for domestic workers , who are disproportionately women and immigrant women.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Olivia Rodrigo biographical records and music charts
occurrences.quote_span: Rodrigo, 23, has made a name channeling the rage and dissatisfaction of modern romance into chart-topping songs that are equal parts Taylor Swift and Alanis Morissette.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields Festival lineup and program records
occurrences.quote_span: Daisy Chain Fields united a women-led lineup boasting queer pop star Chappell Roan , breakout rapper Doechii and riot grrrl pioneers Bikini Kill behind issues of women’s health, workplace protections and legal rights.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Ai-jen Poo's statement
occurrences.quote_span: National Domestic Workers Alliance President Ai-jen Poo said the festival’s joyful atmosphere serves as a “powerful reminder to women everywhere of all ages that, no matter what, we have each other.”
occurrences.speaker: Ai-jen Poo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview with Melissa Shaw and festival attendance records
occurrences.quote_span: Shaw, 33, is driving to the festival from Tucson, Arizona, with her 8-year-old daughter.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields grant agreements and nonprofit grant records
occurrences.quote_span: Charitable partners applauded the grants for general operating support — meaning the nonprofits decide how to spend the money.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields donation announcement and nonprofit grant records
occurrences.quote_span: Ahead of Saturday’s festival in Irvine, California, Rodrigo announced the show had already raised enough to make a $10 million donation to 10 nonprofit partners including Planned Parenthood, National Women’s Law Center and Black Mamas Matter Alliance.
occurrences.speaker: Olivia Rodrigo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: National Women's Law Center grant records and litigation filings
occurrences.quote_span: For the National Women’s Law Center, the gift offers flexibility to plug their own budgetary holes as they litigate sex discrimination cases.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Daisy Chain Fields site map, partner records and event program
occurrences.quote_span: Daisy Chain Fields invited nonprofit partners to engage with fans in its “philanthropy village.”
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Angela Doyinsola Aina's statement
occurrences.quote_span: Black Mamas Matter Alliance co-founder Angela Doyinsola Aina said that support “is often the hardest kind of funding to raise and the most useful kind to receive, because it sustains the training, convening, and advocacy that make everything else possible.”
occurrences.speaker: Angela Doyinsola Aina
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Pivotal Ventures pledge announcement and Daisy Chain Fields event records
occurrences.quote_span: Philanthropist Melinda French Gates pledged another $10 million through her Pivotal Ventures in a surprise appearance at the start of Rodrigo’s set, calling her “a force” and praising her for “showing a new generation how much their voices matter.”
occurrences.speaker: Melinda French Gates
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival

occurrences.checkable_against: AP interview transcript or recording of Olivia Rodrigo's Friday remarks
occurrences.quote_span: “That’s actually why I fell in love with the name ‘Daisy Chain,’” she said Friday.
occurrences.speaker: Olivia Rodrigo
occurrences.subject: Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival
